subject: Next steps: technical demo + security/procurement introductions
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acmehealth.com>, Lara Chen <lara.chen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, Nov 02 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: technical demo + security/procurement introductions

Hi Samir / Lara —

Really enjoyed the call today — thanks for the context on your compliance needs and the priority around SSO and audit logs. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Demo / technical deep dive: we should schedule a 60-min session for the engineering and security stakeholders where we walk through the platform, SSO, KV caching behavior for cost control, and the audit log exports.

2) Stakeholder introductions: can you loop in whoever owns procurement and information security at Acme so we can align on evidence and contractual timelines? We typically include a technical contact, a security contact (for SOC2/penetration test evidence), and procurement for T&Cs.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed Nov 10, 1:00–2:00pm PT (preferred)
- Tue Nov 9, 10:00–11:00am PT (backup)

If neither works, send a couple times that do and I will coordinate internally. I’ve attached a short demo agenda (demo-agenda-v1.docx) and a one-page mutual action plan that outlines the typical sequence for pilot -> procurement -> contract.

Who from your side should be on the invite? If you want, I’ll include Rishi (security/product) and Karthik (platform/SSO) from our team — they can handle SOC2 artifacts and SAML/SCIM setup questions.

Next steps: confirm the best slot and the security/procurement contacts I should include.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0148

Attachments: demo-agenda-v1.docx, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the recap — Wed Nov 10 1:00pm PT works well for our team. I’ve cc’d procurement to start the commercial thread.

Security note: I’m looping in our security lead (Lara will introduce her formally) — in the meantime, can you share a SOC2 snapshot and a basic architecture diagram showing where data-at-rest and audit logs live? That will speed our internal review.

Also, procurement will want a rough pricing summary and whether you support SAML SSO and SCIM for automated user provisioning.

Thanks — I’ll wait for the calendar invite.

—Samir

Hi Vanessa —

Procurement here. A few quick items so we can prep on our end: 

1) Timeline: we need commercial terms and a redlineable contract by Nov 16 to meet budget committee timelines. Please confirm if you can provide a draft SLA and standard terms by Nov 12.
2) Pricing: send a short pricing summary (T&M vs committed capacity options) and any pilot pricing/credits you offer.
3) Contract exchange: we prefer DocuSign — please send the initial agreement to procurement@acmehealth.com.

I started a DocuSign draft (link below) with placeholder language — feel free to send your version or accept for redlining. Also, we require an architecture diagram and evidence that audit logs are retained for at least 90 days.

DocuSign draft: https://docusign.com/rooms/abc123/redwood-acme-draft

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, Nov 05 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: technical demo + security/procurement introductions

Hi all —

I’ll join the Nov 10 demo and can share the SOC2 snapshot and architecture diagram ahead of time. Attaching the artifacts we typically provide for initial reviews: SOC2-snapshot-2026Q3.pdf and redwood-architecture-diagram.png. Quick notes:

- SOC2: scope covers our hosted API and control plane; last attestation 2026 Q3, summary attached (we do not attach the full report to prospects by default — can arrange NDA or secure transfer if that’s required).
- Audit logs: retained 90 days in primary region (US-WEST-2) with optional extended retention for Enterprise. Exports available via S3 or secure API.
- SSO/SCIM: Redwood supports SAML 2.0-based SSO and SCIM for provisioning. For the demo we’ll show a SAML login flow and a SCIM user create. Karthik will cover connectivity/ports and timeline for provisioning.

I also think a 30-min internal pre-demo on Mon Nov 9, 10:30am PT is a good idea — I’m available. Vanessa, please put a calendar invite on the thread if that works.

Attachments: SOC2-snapshot-2026Q3.pdf, redwood-architecture-diagram.png

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Product Security | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
